history.Chinese:
用法：history [条数] | history -c <chat> | history -a | history --help
功能：查看你向 AI 问过的问题（记录在 ~/.ai_s/chat/<chat>.json，每次 AI 交互自动记录）
示例：
  history - 查看当前 chat 最近 10 条提问
  history 20 - 查看最近 20 条提问
  history -c first - 查看 chat 'first' 的提问
  history -a - 查看所有 chat 的提问
适配系统：Windows/Linux/Termux全兼容
history.English:
Usage: history [count] | history -c <chat> | history -a | history --help
Function: View the questions you asked the AI (recorded automatically in ~/.ai_s/chat/<chat>.json on every AI interaction)
Examples:
  history - View last 10 questions in current chat
  history 20 - View last 20 questions
  history -c first - View questions in chat 'first'
  history -a - View questions across all chats
Compatible systems: Windows/Linux/Termux
